notes:
## Changes

- **Torrent check has been redesigned.** It now opens straight away: drop a .torrent file on the window, paste one with Ctrl+V, or choose one. You'll see how much of the torrent appears to be in your collection already, how much is still to download, which of its folders you already have, and how each file matched.
  - Files are matched in several ways: the same name and size, the same size, a similar name (ignoring things like 1080p or x265 in the name), or the same episode code such as S02E04. Each file is marked **Appears to be in your collection**, **Might be in your collection** or **New**, with the reasons shown beside it.
  - Torrents that hold a single file can now be checked too.
  - You can check another torrent without closing the window.
- **Folder duplicates has been redesigned** in the same way. Drop a folder on the window, paste one, or choose one, and see which of its videos are already in your collection, how much space you could free, and which collection folders the copies are in.
  - Only videos whose size matches a scene are opened to check their length, so it's much quicker. You can see its progress and stop it part-way.
  - It checks the folder itself, not its subfolders. It needs ffmpeg, and says so in the window if it isn't set up.
  - **Show in File Explorer** opens the video you pick.
- Both windows can stay open while you carry on using Video Shelf.

## Fixes

- A damaged or unfinished torrent file no longer closes Video Shelf. The window says it couldn't read the file instead.
- Torrent check no longer misses a match only because of upper or lower case in a file name.
